note: Patterns of the static secret scan of a release artifact. A pattern is an ECMAScript regular expression; ios-ci/secret-scan.mjs applies it to the bytes of every file read as ISO 8859-1 text, and again to the same bytes without NUL bytes (ASCII text stored as UTF-16). A match is a finding for the security review, not a verdict: the scan records where it is and never prints it.

patterns.what: a private key in PEM armour
an access key id of a cloud account
an API key of a cloud project
an access token of a source hosting account
a fine-grained access token of a source hosting account
a token of a chat workspace
a live key of a payment account
a JSON web key with its private member
a credential assigned as a quoted literal
a URL that carries a user name and a password

private_material: The synthetic lab keys of the dataset are public by design, but only their public halves ship. The scan derives the four private seeds the way the data generator does and searches every file for each seed as raw bytes, as its PKCS#8 encoding and as hexadecimal, base64 and base64url text.
